description: This file contains lowerings, utilities, and registration functions related to MKL-DNN (oneDNN) optimizations within PyTorch's _inductor backend. It defines functions for creating quantization compensation, code generation for int8 GEMM templates, and registers lowering handlers for various MKL-DNN operations including convolution, linear, and qlinear operators, with support for autotuning and template choices.

methods.description: Calculates and creates compensation tensors for int8 quantized weights, accounting for scale and zero-point parameters, optimizing for fast compensation path when possible.

methods.description: Generates code for int8 GEMM operations with optional compensation based on path; applies necessary scaling and subtraction for quantized operations.

methods.name: grouped_gemm_lowering( x: TensorBox, w: list[TensorBox], b: list[TensorBox], attr=None, scalars=None, algorithm=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Defines lowering for grouped GEMM operations, including autotuning and template selection, supporting dynamic input transformation.

methods.name: register_onednn_fusion_ops()
methods.description: Registers lowering functions for various oneDNN (mkldnn) fusion ops, including convolutions, linear layers, and qlinear operators, with support for kernel choices and autotuning.
